anomalies.description: Multiple players in white jerseys (including #12 Iginla and #21 Gagne) engage in a physical scrum with opposing players near the net, involving grappling, pushing, and helmet-to-helmet contact; the sequence shows sustained mutual combat, not a single check.
Player #12 (Iginla) appears to deliver a forceful blow to an opponent who is already down or off-balance during the scrum, consistent with attacking a helpless victim within the ongoing fight.
Multiple men in suits engage in a physical altercation on an elevated platform, with visible pushing, grabbing, and one individual being restrained or thrown backward.
